notes.title: The Culinary Hunt Update
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh update full of new hunting opportunities and expanded culinary creativity! Here’s what’s cooking in this version:


🥚 A Cozy Home for Eggs
Chickens now have a *dedicated nesting house*! All eggs are collected in one convenient spot—no more searching around the yard.


🐇🕊 Wild Game Appears
The wilderness is now alive with new wildlife—*rabbits* and *birds* roam free. Track them down and hunt for rare ingredients to expand your culinary repertoire.


🥩 New Kitchen Device: the Food processor
A powerful new addition to your cooking arsenal—the Food processor**—has arrived! With it, you can:

Process various sub-products

Unlock a wide variety of new recipes

Create more complex and rewarding dishes

Your kitchen just got a whole lot more exciting.


🗡 Combat Depth and Stealth Mechanics
Enemies now *see and hear* you. Engage wisely:

Stealth your way past or sneak up for a tactical advantage

Noises may alert foes—approach each encounter with care

The battlefield is now more dynamic, and strategy matters more than ever.


⚔️ New Melee Weapons
Two brand-new lootable melee weapons are now available to spice up your combat encounters:

A mighty Battle axe for powerful strikes

A stylish Pirate sword for fast and flashy combat

Choose your weapon and fight in style!



Enjoy the hunt, master the kitchen, and stay sneaky!

notes.title: 🛠️ Update – Quality of Life Improvements (v1.4.4)
notes.content:
We're bringing a fresh wave of comfort and polish to Ale & Tale Tavern! This update focuses on making your experience smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable. Here's what's new:

---

🔍 Helpful Game Hints  
Now added throughout the game to assist you on your journey.

🗺️ Extra Quest Markers  
Never miss your next task — new markers make quests easier to follow.

⚗️ Alchemical Lab Reworked  
Revamped visuals and functionality for smoother potion-making.

⏸️ Pause in Solo Mode  
Need a break? You can now pause while playing solo.

📜 Food Menu Sorted by Level  
Recipes are now organized by level for easier browsing.

🧾 Order Desk Redesigned  
Cleaner and more intuitive — managing orders just got better.

🎯 VIP Orders Stand Out  
Now you won't miss dishes for VIP customers.

🕷️ Arachnophobia Mode Improved  
More effective and player-friendly spider-free mode.

💬 Colored Player Chat Names  
Easier to follow conversations with color-coded names.

🖼️ New Tavern Side-Wall Decor  
A little extra charm added to your surroundings.

🎛️ Hide UI with a Button  
Capture clean screenshots or enjoy a minimal interface.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Minor Enhancements  
Various tweaks under the hood to keep things running smoothly.

---

🎉 Don't Miss This!

We’d love to draw your attention to a brand-new release from our wonderful publisher Grab the Games —  
👉 Kitchen Wars launches today!

Play with friends, cook together, compete, and have a blast! 🍳🔥🏆

Check it out and add some delicious chaos to your game night!

notes.title: Helpers Update. These cute owls will help you run the tavern!
notes.content:
Ale & Tale Tavern: Major Update – Meet the Owl Helpers and More!

We are excited to announce a major update for Ale & Tale Tavern! This update brings significant improvements and new features that will drastically enhance your gameplay experience. Let’s dive into what’s new:

---

🦉 Owl Helpers – Automate Your Tavern!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/e702b22f4b9a81251a1a8ea7bbc33d716fec057b.gif

In response to player feedback, we’ve introduced owl helpers to the game! These cute, intelligent creatures are here to assist with the daily operations of your tavern. Whether it’s cleaning, collecting dirty dishes, taking orders, or serving meals, the owl helpers will automate much of the tavern routine, giving you more time to explore and focus on other activities.

- Cleaner Owl: Helps with cleaning the tavern and maintaining order.  
- Waiter Owl: Takes orders and serves food to the customers.

Players can easily activate these helpers by purchasing their respective owl houses from the in-game shop. This feature was highly requested, with over 80% of players asking for automated helpers, particularly for solo players who found the tavern work overwhelming. Now, even solo players can enjoy a more relaxed and engaging gameplay experience!

---

⚔️ Combat System Overhaul

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/7a904d09cc6dc9e99af421328ac171ee164a8d8e.gif

We’ve made major improvements to the combat system, making battles more dynamic and skill-based. Both player abilities and enemy behaviors have been enhanced:

- New player abilities: Block, Dash, and Empowered Attacks.
- Smarter enemies: Orcs can block and counter-attack, while spiders and other creatures have new attack patterns.  
- Improved enemy agility: Wolves, boars, and bears are now more challenging, with new jumping and unblockable attacks.  
- Enhanced combat animations: Animations are smoother and more immersive.  
- Orc rework: Orcs have received a full animation and visual overhaul, making them look and move better than ever.

These changes make battles more diverse and require strategic thinking, offering a fresh, exciting combat experience.

---

🌿 Additional Features and Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/825b03a9a5d99f75eb2be455d3226d87ef4cb651.gif

We’ve also added numerous smaller features and quality-of-life improvements, many of which were directly requested by players. Here are just a few:

Tavern renaming: Personalize your tavern by giving it a unique name!
New high-level items: A more powerful broom, hoe, and other tools are now available.
Cheaper respawning: Reviving is now more affordable.
Bigger bucket capacity: Carry more with an upgraded bucket.
Improved NPC animations: NPCs in the tavern now move with more variety, bringing life to your establishment.
Expanded garden beds and second animal pen: Grow your resources with more farming space.
Light potion: Carry light while wielding a weapon for better exploration at night.
And much more!

---

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the new and improved Ale & Tale Tavern!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue with the cave closing after completing the cave quest. Now, after defeating the Boss, the cave will always remain open.
2. Updated the mug shelf icon to the correct one.
3. Turtles now appear more frequently.
4. Fixed the bug where there were 0 dishes on the Dual Burner Stove.
5. The puddle and hay no longer interact with the tavern’s front door.
6. Improved the interface for multi-step cooking dishes. Some players were unclear that certain dishes needed to be cooked in stages.
7. Fixed the bug where break mess spawns multiple times after loading.
8. Fixed the issue where some visitors appeared without clothes.
9. Corrected a slip in the Deer’s dialogue.
10. Quest items are now forcibly moved into the inventory. This fixes the issue for players who encountered problems with the Herbalist quest. For those who have already faced the problem, the quest items will appear in the inventory 30 seconds after starting the game session.
11. Cloud saves have been implemented.
12. Chickens and pigs no longer run out of the paddock. This was not a bug. These creatures used to escape the pen and run into the tavern if they weren’t fed for a long time. However, many players didn’t understand what was happening. We’ve temporarily removed this feature and will consider how to present it more clearly.
13. Fixed the issue with the sound hanging on the automatic dishwasher.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Dear Tavern-goers!

Thank you for spending time in the game and sharing your impressions. This is extremely important and helps make the game better!

1. We would like to apologize to some players for an unfortunate bug that we missed — a bug related to autosaves. They were not working correctly. Some players lost their progress, and we are very sorry that this happened. This patch has fixed that issue, and now autosaves work properly.

2. We also fixed the rare bug in the quest with the Herbalist and Mandrake.

3. Additionally, several smaller fixes were made, improving visuals, shadow and light rendering, and more.

PS We are currently working on cloud saves, which will be added to the game as soon as possible. We are also paying attention to your other feedback and taking everything into consideration.

Thank you for being here, dear Tavern-goers!
